# Outbound — Persona 5: Creators (newsletters, YouTubers, course sellers)

Who: creators monetizing an audience but leaking sales: Gumroad-only presence,
link-in-bio mazes, no home base they own, launches run entirely in DMs.
Find them: newsletter "about" pages without sites, YouTube descriptions with
10+ links, course sellers on marketplaces, X creators with paid products.

Angle: own your home base — one fast page that collects emails and sells while
they create. Never insult their content; only the sales path.

## Personalization variables (fill ALL before sending — ~3 min research)

- `[FirstName]` — creator's first name
- `[Channel]` — their main channel ("your newsletter", "your YouTube channel")
- `[Topic]` — what they teach/make, in their words
- `[SpecificObservation]` — ONE concrete thing (e.g. "your latest video sends buyers to 4 different links and none collect email")
- `[ConcreteFix]` — ONE fix (e.g. "a single home page: email capture + your course + booking link, in that order")
- `[DayOption]` — two specific days

## Anti-spam rules (all 4 templates)

1. Lead with genuine familiarity — name a real piece of their work.
2. First two lines must contain `[SpecificObservation]`.
3. One follow-up max, 4–5 business days later, then drop. Never pitch in public replies.
4. Every message includes an easy out. Max 10 new prospects/day. No automation.
5. Never promise subscribers, views, or revenue. Fixed-price builds only.

---

## 5A. Email — the home-base pitch

Subject: a home base for `[Topic]`?

> Hi `[FirstName]`,
>
> Been following `[Channel]` — your `[specific piece: "issue on pricing freelance work" / "video on X"]` was genuinely useful. One thing I noticed:
> `[SpecificObservation]`.
>
> I build single home-base pages for creators: `[ConcreteFix]`. One fast page
> you own, collecting emails and selling while you make the next thing. Fixed
> price upfront — typically a small fraction of one launch.
>
> I do $5, 60-min idea calls: we map the page, fixed quote attached, plan's
> yours either way. Open `[DayOption]`?
>
> If the link-maze is working fine, say so — one check-in max from me.
>
> — `[YourName]`, `[Studio]` · `[portfolio/GitHub link]`

## 5B. LinkedIn/X DM — short and warm (only DM if their DMs are open and they engage with replies)

> Hi `[FirstName]` — loved your `[specific piece]` on `[Channel]`. Quick
> observation from a builder: `[SpecificObservation]`.
>
> I make home-base pages for creators (`[ConcreteFix]`, fixed price, you own
> it all). Happy to sketch yours on a $5 call — plan's yours either way. Worth
> a look, or is the current setup converting fine?

## 5C. Discord/Slack DM — only in creator communities where you're an active member

> hey `[FirstName]` — really liked your `[specific piece]`, shared it with a
> friend learning `[Topic]`. Builder's note: `[SpecificObservation]`.
>
> I do one-page home bases for creators — `[ConcreteFix]` is the pattern that
> works. If you ever want it mapped out, I do $5 idea calls with a fixed quote.
> Totally optional — keep making the stuff, it's good.

## 5D. Follow-up (ONE, 4–5 business days later)

Subject: Re: a home base for `[Topic]`?

> Hi `[FirstName]` — checking in once: is the home-base idea (`[ConcreteFix]`)
> worth a $5 mapping call, or should I close this out?
>
> Either way's fine — if a launch is coming up, happy to reconnect ahead of it
> instead.
>
> — `[YourName]`

(No second follow-up. Log outcome, move on.)
